title: Remember Winston Churchill: Epitaph
paragraphs: It is all true, or it ought to be; and more and better besides. And wherever men are fighting against barbarism, tyranny, and massacre, for freedom, law, and honour, let them remember that the fame of their deeds, even though they themselves be exterminated, may perhaps be celebrated as long as the world rolls round.
—WINSTON CHURCHILL, A History of the English-Speaking Peoples
